name: saltleecher
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite atlas. Use the attached approved Saltmarrow concept sheet as visual reference; faithfully match the character identity, silhouette, teal spectral water, brass/rust details, dark outlines. Create one transparent PNG atlas, exactly 1024x1024, regular 4 columns x 4 rows of equal 256px cells. NO TEXT, NO LABELS, NO GRID, NO BACKGROUND, no shadows outside cells. Columns are poses: column1 idle, column2 walk left foot forward, column3 walk right foot forward, column4 extended attack/ability. Consistent anatomy and costume in every frame. Subject: SALTLEECHER, the huge squat segmented aquatic lamprey with enormous circular toothed maw, pale moss brown armored back, tiny fins and teal water splashes. Attack opens and thrusts its red maw.
